description: Quantify charge on the concave (membrane-facing) surface of the amphiphysin, ACAP1 and ACAP3 BAR dimers
code:
import numpy as np, json
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
Z=np.load("bar_models.npz"); meta=json.load(open("bar_models_res.json"))
sets={"Amphiphysin BAR dimer\n(1URU, positive control)":("amph","#4a4a4a"),
      "ACAP1 BAR dimer\n(4NSW crystal)":("acap1","#4a4a4a"),
      "ACAP3 BAR dimer\n(AlphaFold on 4NSW)":("acap3","#4a4a4a")}
summary={}
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(15,4.8),sharey=True)
for ax,(lab,(key,_)) in zip(axes,sets.items()):
    SC=Z[key+"_sc"]; CA=Z[key+"_ca"]; res=meta[key]
    aa=np.array([r[2] for r in res])
    q=np.where(np.isin(aa,list("KR")),1,np.where(np.isin(aa,list("DE")),-1,0))
    # burial proxy: number of CA neighbours within 10 A
    Dn=np.linalg.norm(CA[:,None,:]-CA[None,:,:],axis=2)
    nb=(Dn<10).sum(1)-1
    surface = nb <= np.median(nb)
    C=SC.mean(0); Y=SC-C
    U,S,Vt=np.linalg.svd(Y,full_matrices=False); pc=Y@Vt.T
    # choose the axis carrying crescent curvature
    best=None
    for k in (1,2):
        co=np.polyfit(pc[:,0],pc[:,k],2)
        if best is None or abs(co[0])>abs(best[1][0]): best=(k,co)
    k,co=best; sgn=np.sign(co[0])
    off = sgn*(pc[:,k]-np.polyval(co,pc[:,0]))   # >0 = concave side
    thr=np.percentile(off[surface],66.7)
    face = surface & (off>=thr)
    nK=int((q[face]==1).sum()); nD=int((q[face]==-1).sum())
    allK=int((q==1).sum()); allD=int((q==-1).sum())
    summary[key]=dict(n_res=len(res),n_surface=int(surface.sum()),n_concave=int(face.sum()),
                      concave_KR=nK,concave_DE=nD,concave_net=nK-nD,
                      concave_net_per100=round((nK-nD)/face.sum()*100,1),
                      whole_KR=allK,whole_DE=allD,whole_net=allK-allD)
    print(f"{lab.splitlines()[0]:<28} concave surface n={face.sum():3d}  K/R={nK:2d} D/E={nD:2d} "
          f"net={nK-nD:+3d} ({(nK-nD)/face.sum()*100:+.1f} per 100 res) | whole dimer net={allK-allD:+d}")
    col=np.where(q==1,"#2166ac",np.where(q==-1,"#b2182b","#d9d9d9"))
    ax.scatter(pc[~face,0],off[~face],c="#ececec",s=18,edgecolor='none')
    ax.scatter(pc[face,0],off[face],c=col[face],s=42,edgecolor='none')
    ax.axhline(thr,color='k',lw=0.7,ls='--')
    ax.set_title(lab,fontsize=10); ax.set_xlabel("position along BAR long axis (A)")
    ax.text(0.03,0.95,f"concave net charge {nK-nD:+d}",transform=ax.transAxes,va='top',fontsize=10)
axes[0].set_ylabel("offset from fitted crescent arc (A)\npositive = concave (membrane) face")
from matplotlib.lines import Line2D
axes[2].legend(handles=[Line2D([],[],marker='o',ls='',color="#2166ac",label="Lys/Arg"),
                        Line2D([],[],marker='o',ls='',color="#b2182b",label="Asp/Glu"),
                        Line2D([],[],marker='o',ls='',color="#d9d9d9",label="not on concave face")],
               loc="lower right",frameon=False,fontsize=8)
fig.suptitle("Charge on the BAR concave face: ACAP3 and ACAP1 lack the basic surface of amphiphysin",y=1.0,fontsize=12)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
json.dump(summary,open("bar_concave_charge_v2.json","w"),indent=1)
